note: Real run on 2026-10-06 through the InsightfulPipe MCP on a client Google Ads account, anonymised: firm, attorney, state, city, phone, directory, competitor firm and competitor brand names replaced, identifying counts shown as N+ or N, ids removed. request: Hey Claude, I just added the "copywriting" skill. Rewrite the hero and headlines of my traffic ticket landing page in the words my searchers actually use, and review what's there now.

account.name: A US criminal and traffic defense law firm

asset.job: website copy and headlines, plus a copy review
asset.picked_by: most paid clicks of any landing page (E1)

window_rule: The page's campaigns had 760 search-term impressions in the last 30 days, under 1,000, so the run uses 90 days.
the_one_action: a call, text or case-evaluation request (the account's counted conversions)
reader: inferred from E1 and E2, not given by the user: a driver with a traffic or speeding ticket in [State] (some from out of state, some with a commercial licence), comparing lawyers (63 competitor-name terms) and asking what it costs (48 cost terms). Success in the first week: knowing their options and the fee before the court date.
proof_offered: the review count, directory rating, years of experience and charges-resolved count already in the live ads; listed under claims to confirm
brand_terms: the firm's name; the Brand campaign sends no traffic to this page

data_pulled.result: 5 live ads in 2 campaigns point at the page

data_pulled.call: E2 google-ads search_terms_report, once per campaign (campaign_id), limit 5000
data_pulled.result: 578 rows, 397 distinct terms after adding rows up by term
not used: the business's site isn't connected to Search Console
73 rows, 15 distinct lines in the page's campaigns

data_pulled.call: E5 dataforseo onpage_instant_pages with the copy reader
result: JavaScript rendering, default user agent: status 403, broken
retry with a desktop browser user agent and accept_language en-US: status 403, broken

data_pulled.call: E6 dataforseo serp_google_organic, keyword '[State] traffic ticket attorney' (matches the page's URL slug), location_code 2840, en, depth 10
data_pulled.result: 1 competing seller among 9 organic results (4 directories or matching services, 4 of the firm's other pages); this page doesn't rank. Fewer than 3 sellers, so one close variant was tried.

data_pulled.call: E6 dataforseo serp_google_organic, keyword '[State] traffic ticket lawyer' (the variant), location_code 2840, en, depth 10
data_pulled.result: 6 competing sellers among 9 organic results; this page ranks at position 9; 3 local listings, 4 People Also Ask questions. This results page is the one used.
